ex.en: If he studied hard, he would pass the test.
ex.zh: 如果他用功讀書，就會通過考試。

ex.zh: 芭芭拉昨天考駕照考得怎樣？

ex.zh: 現在的老師超愛考試，聽說今天又要考了。

ex.zh: 我去醫院檢查了眼睛。

ex.zh: 新軟體發布前我們需要先測試。

ex.zh: 湯姆告訴我他丟了課本。

ex.zh: 這所學校為學生提供教科書。

ex.zh: 我把課本翻到最後一頁。

ex.zh: 這種藥可以暫時緩解疼痛，你需要的話就拿去吧。

ex.zh: 這家店因整修暫停營業。

ex.zh: 網站暫時無法使用。

ex.zh: 台灣在科技方面領先。

ex.zh: 由於科技產業聚集，新竹市的房價大幅上漲。

ex.zh: 他在台北一家科技公司上班。

ex.zh: 筆電開不了機就打給技術支援。

ex.zh: 技術人員十分鐘就修好了我的電腦。

ex.zh: 銀行櫃員把錢數了兩次。

ex.zh: 請到下一個空著的櫃檯辦理。

telecommunication.zh: 電信、遠距通訊（常用複數）

ex.en: He works in the telecommunication industry.
ex.zh: 他在電信業工作。

ex.en: Telecommunication networks connect the whole world.
ex.zh: 電信網路把全世界連結在一起。

teen.zh: 青少年；（複數 teens）十幾歲的年紀

ex.en: My sister got married in her teens.
ex.zh: 我姊姊十幾歲就結婚了。

ex.en: He was still in his teens when he founded a company.
ex.zh: 他創立公司的時候還不到二十歲。

ex.en: My daughter is in her late teens.
ex.zh: 我女兒快二十歲了。

ex.en: Tom is a teen idol.
ex.zh: 湯姆是青少年偶像。

ex.en: Teen drivers have to take extra lessons.
ex.zh: 青少年駕駛必須多上一些課程。

tempt.zh: 誘惑、吸引（be tempted to：很想去做）

ex.en: Even though she is dieting, the chocolate cake still tempts her.
ex.zh: 雖然她在節食，巧克力蛋糕還是很吸引她。

ex.zh: 我不是故意要誘惑你。

ex.en: I was tempted to quit my job.
ex.zh: 我很想辭職。

ex.zh: 合約允許提前三十天通知終止。

ex.en: He received a letter of termination.
ex.zh: 他收到了解僱通知書。

ex.en: You look terrific in that suit!
ex.zh: 你穿那套西裝真好看！

ex.en: We had a terrific time in Japan.
ex.zh: 我們在日本玩得超開心。

ex.en: A car went by at terrific speed.
ex.zh: 一輛車以極快的速度呼嘯而過。

ex.en: The new job puts a terrific amount of pressure on him.
ex.zh: 這份新工作給他極大的壓力。

ex.en: The government passed new laws to fight terrorism.
ex.zh: 政府通過新法打擊恐怖主義。

ex.zh: 由於擔心恐怖攻擊，機場加強了安檢。

ex.zh: 她在一家大型電信公司上班。

ex.en: The telecom industry is very competitive.
ex.zh: 電信業競爭非常激烈。

ex.en: We live in an age of rapid technological change.
ex.zh: 我們生活在科技快速變遷的時代。

ex.en: The company is a technological leader in its field.
ex.zh: 這家公司在其領域是技術領導者。

ex.en: He was rigid with terror.
ex.zh: 他嚇得全身僵硬。

ex.en: She screamed in terror.
ex.zh: 她嚇得尖叫。

ex.zh: 恐怖攻擊後，城市進入警戒狀態。

ex.zh: 政府正在打擊恐怖主義。

ex.zh: 他們的主要出口品是紡織品，尤其是絲綢和棉布。

ex.zh: 蘇格蘭以羊毛紡織品聞名。

ex.zh: 台灣的紡織業以機能性布料聞名。

ex.zh: 她在一家紡織公司上班。

ex.en: Technically, the store is closed, but they let us in.
ex.zh: 嚴格來說店已經打烊了，但他們還是讓我們進去。

ex.en: Technically, you are right, but it's not that simple.
ex.zh: 照理說你是對的，但事情沒那麼簡單。

ex.zh: 這個專案在技術上很困難。

ex.zh: 這支新手機在技術上令人驚豔。

ex.en: You can use this template for your report.
ex.zh: 你可以用這個範本來寫報告。

ex.en: Download the template from our website.
ex.zh: 請從我們的網站下載範本。

ex.zh: 證人在法庭上作證。

ex.zh: 他的證詞幫忙證明了她的清白。

ex.en: The product's success is a testimony to the team's hard work.
ex.zh: 這項產品的成功證明了團隊的努力。

ex.en: Her long career is testimony to her talent.
ex.zh: 她漫長的職業生涯證明了她的才華。

ex.en: During her tenure as CEO, profits doubled.
ex.zh: 在她擔任執行長期間，獲利翻倍。

ex.en: His tenure at the company lasted ten years.
ex.zh: 他在公司任職了十年。

ex.en: The professor finally got tenure.
ex.zh: 那位教授終於拿到終身職。

ex.en: Tenure gives teachers job security.
ex.zh: 終身職讓教師有工作保障。

ex.en: She testified that she saw the man.
ex.zh: 她作證說她看到了那名男子。

ex.en: He is not willing to testify for his compatriot.
ex.zh: 他不願意為同胞作證。

ex.en: The lawyer warned his client against testifying, but he did it anyway.
ex.zh: 律師警告當事人不要作證，但他還是作證了。

ex.en: The awards testify to the quality of our service.
ex.zh: 這些獎項證明了我們的服務品質。

ex.en: Her success testifies to years of hard work.
ex.zh: 她的成功證明了多年來的努力。

ex.en: You should have told me a long time ago.
ex.zh: 你早該告訴我的。

ex.en: I have no intention of telling you the result.
ex.zh: 我不打算告訴你結果。

ex.en: The teacher tells us to clean our classroom every day.
ex.zh: 老師要我們每天打掃教室。

ex.en: My boss told me to send the report.
ex.zh: 老闆叫我把報告寄出去。

ex.en: I can't tell the difference between them.
ex.zh: 我分不出它們的差別。

ex.en: Can you tell the twins apart?
ex.zh: 你分得出那對雙胞胎嗎？

ex.en: Grandpa likes to tell stories.
ex.zh: 爺爺喜歡講故事。

ex.en: Tell me about your trip.
ex.zh: 跟我說說你的旅行。

ex.en: None of the teachers could solve the problem.
ex.zh: 沒有一個老師能解決這個問題。

ex.en: Students generally like a teacher who understands their problems.
ex.zh: 學生通常喜歡能理解他們問題的老師。

ex.en: The students noted down every word the teacher said.
ex.zh: 學生們把老師說的每個字都記了下來。

ex.en: Could you teach me how to play the piano?
ex.zh: 你可以教我彈鋼琴嗎？

ex.en: He was my student. Now he teaches my children.
ex.zh: 他以前是我的學生，現在在教我的孩子。

ex.en: Parents teach their children that it's wrong to lie.
ex.zh: 父母教導孩子說謊是不對的。

ex.en: Modern technology has made our lives more comfortable.
ex.zh: 現代科技讓我們的生活更舒適。

ex.en: Japan is highly competitive in high technology industries.
ex.zh: 日本在高科技產業很有競爭力。

ex.en: The laptop provides cutting-edge technology at an affordable price.
ex.zh: 這款筆電價格實惠，技術領先。

ex.en: Nowadays, almost every home has one or two televisions.
ex.zh: 現在幾乎每戶人家都有一兩台電視。

ex.en: Today no one can imagine a life without television.
ex.zh: 現在沒有人能想像沒有電視的生活。

ex.en: In our house there are two televisions.
ex.zh: 我們家有兩台電視。

ex.en: He tends to be late for meetings.
ex.zh: 他開會常常遲到。

ex.en: People living in a big city tend to lack exercise.
ex.zh: 住在大城市的人往往缺乏運動。

ex.en: People tend to look at others with bias.
ex.zh: 人們往往帶著偏見看別人。

ex.en: Nurses tend patients day and night.
ex.zh: 護理師日夜照顧病人。

ex.en: She tends her garden every morning.
ex.zh: 她每天早上照料花園。

ex.en: When I was taking a bath, the telephone rang.
ex.zh: 我正在洗澡的時候電話響了。

ex.en: May I use your telephone?
ex.zh: 我可以借用你的電話嗎？

ex.en: I was about to leave when you telephoned.
ex.zh: 你打電話來的時候我正要出門。

ex.en: Sorry for telephoning you so early.
ex.zh: 抱歉這麼早打電話給你。

ex.en: It was Mike that telephoned the police.
ex.zh: 是麥克打電話報警的。

ex.en: I don't have time to translate this text.
ex.zh: 我沒時間翻譯這段文字。

ex.zh: 請把這段文字從日文翻成法文。

ex.en: I'll send you a text when I arrive.
ex.zh: 我到了會傳簡訊給你。

ex.en: Did you get my text?
ex.zh: 你有收到我的簡訊嗎？

ex.en: She texted her boyfriend.
ex.zh: 她傳了簡訊給男朋友。

ex.en: Why are you texting all the time?
ex.zh: 你為什麼一直在傳簡訊？

ex.en: A number of imaging techniques are employed in radiology, such as X-ray, MRI, and ultrasound.
ex.zh: 放射學使用多種影像技術，例如 X 光、MRI 和超音波。

ex.en: She learned new sales techniques at the workshop.
ex.zh: 她在研習會學到新的銷售技巧。

ex.en: Good breathing technique is important for singers.
ex.zh: 良好的呼吸技巧對歌手很重要。

ex.en: We're having some technical problems with the website.
ex.zh: 我們的網站出了一些技術問題。

ex.en: Please contact technical support for help.
ex.zh: 請聯絡技術支援部門尋求協助。

ex.zh: 他的技術能力很強。

ex.en: The report is full of technical terms.
ex.zh: 這份報告充滿專業術語。

ex.en: Try not to use too much technical language.
ex.zh: 盡量不要用太多專業用語。

ex.en: I could not keep the tears from my eyes.
ex.zh: 我忍不住流下眼淚。

ex.en: She burst into tears when she heard the news.
ex.zh: 她聽到消息時突然哭了出來。

ex.zh: 這個小嬰兒把一張十美元鈔票撕破了。

ex.en: Be careful not to tear the paper.
ex.zh: 小心別把紙撕破。

ex.en: They will tear down the old building in two days.
ex.zh: 他們會在兩天內拆除這棟舊建築。

ex.en: The house in which we lived was torn down.
ex.zh: 我們以前住的房子被拆掉了。

ex.en: Would you like to have a cup of tea?
ex.zh: 你想喝杯茶嗎？

ex.en: Two teas and a coffee, please.
ex.zh: 請給我兩杯茶和一杯咖啡。

ex.en: Add a little more milk to my tea, please.
ex.zh: 請在我的茶裡多加一點牛奶。

ex.en: I know that Tom is a terrible singer.
ex.zh: 我知道湯姆唱歌很難聽。

ex.zh: 熬夜對皮膚很不好。

ex.zh: 我今天上班過得糟透了。

ex.en: The terrible scene made him tremble in fear.
ex.zh: 那可怕的場面讓他嚇得發抖。

ex.zh: 高速公路上發生了一起嚴重的車禍。

ex.en: They said the situation was only temporary.
ex.zh: 他們說情況只是暫時的。

ex.en: A permanent job is better than a temporary one.
ex.zh: 正職工作比臨時工作好。

ex.en: The office is closed due to a temporary power outage.
ex.zh: 辦公室因暫時停電而關閉。

ex.en: It is easy for me to play tennis.
ex.zh: 打網球對我來說很簡單。

ex.zh: 我高中時常打網球。

ex.zh: 我有些同學喜歡排球，有些喜歡網球。

ex.en: There is growing tension between the two departments.
ex.zh: 兩個部門之間的關係越來越緊張。

ex.zh: 談判過程中氣氛越來越緊繃。

ex.zh: 瑜伽有助於放鬆肩膀的緊繃。

ex.zh: 我們絕不會向恐怖分子的要求屈服。

ex.zh: 我痛恨恐怖組織。

ex.zh: 我覺得自己好像又變回青少年了。

ex.zh: 湯姆是個普通的青少年。

ex.zh: 青少年常穿奇裝異服。

ex.en: It seems to me that she has a tendency to exaggerate.
ex.zh: 在我看來，她有誇大其詞的傾向。

ex.zh: 人們往往認為滑翔翼很危險。

ex.en: There is a growing tendency to shop online.
ex.zh: 網購的趨勢越來越明顯。

ex.en: This is a good place to pitch a tent.
ex.zh: 這裡很適合搭帳篷。

ex.en: The school will provide tents for us.
ex.zh: 學校會提供帳篷給我們。

ex.zh: 我們花了半小時搭好帳篷。

ex.en: The study looked at temporal changes in sales.
ex.zh: 這項研究探討銷售額隨時間的變化。

ex.en: The film plays with temporal order.
ex.zh: 這部電影打亂了時間順序。

ex.en: You look tense.
ex.zh: 你看起來很緊張。

ex.en: Everyone seems tense.
ex.zh: 每個人似乎都很緊張。

ex.en: The situation seemed very tense and dangerous.
ex.zh: 情勢看起來非常緊張危險。

ex.en: My shoulders tense up when I'm stressed.
ex.zh: 我壓力大的時候肩膀會緊繃。

ex.en: He tensed his muscles before lifting the box.
ex.zh: 他搬箱子前先繃緊肌肉。

ex.en: Use the past tense to describe what happened yesterday.
ex.zh: 描述昨天發生的事要用過去式。

ex.en: The verb is in the present tense.
ex.zh: 這個動詞是現在式。

ex.en: Legal terminology is not comprehensible to most laypeople.
ex.zh: 大多數一般人都看不懂法律術語。

ex.en: Legal terminology is usually incomprehensible to non-specialists.
ex.zh: 法律術語通常讓非專業人士難以理解。

ex.en: I was terribly confused by his question.
ex.zh: 他的問題讓我非常困惑。

ex.en: If I've misjudged you, I'm terribly sorry.
ex.zh: 如果我誤會你了，我真的很抱歉。

ex.en: I am terribly hungry.
ex.zh: 我餓壞了。

ex.en: The team played terribly last night.
ex.zh: 球隊昨晚表現得很糟。

ex.en: I slept terribly because of the noise.
ex.zh: 因為噪音，我睡得很差。

ex.zh: 我們暫定星期五見面。

ex.en: These dates are only tentative.
ex.zh: 這些日期都只是暫定的。

ex.zh: 她遲疑地對他笑了一下。

ex.zh: 他在冰上小心翼翼地走了幾步。

ex.zh: 我很喜歡這麵 Q 彈的口感。

ex.zh: 有些人不喜歡豆腐的口感。

ex.zh: 線條藝術著重形狀和輪廓，而非色彩、陰影和質感。

ex.en: This fabric has a soft texture.
ex.zh: 這種布料的質地很柔軟。

ex.zh: 我們今年和不少強隊交手過。

ex.zh: 大多數球隊打主場時表現比較好。

ex.zh: 湯姆和瑪麗總是組隊一起工作。

ex.zh: 當地企業正聯手推動一項慈善活動。

ex.zh: 兩個品牌聯手推出一款新球鞋。

ex.zh: 氣溫已經連續好幾天在零度以下。

ex.zh: 低溫使水變成冰。

ex.zh: 在高溫下反應會更快發生。

ex.zh: 如果她的體溫升高，就去請醫生來。

ex.zh: 人體的溫度大約在攝氏 37 度上下。

ex.zh: 崎嶇的地形讓部隊難以前進。

ex.zh: 這輛車是為崎嶇地形設計的。

ex.zh: 她脾氣有點壞。

ex.zh: 他脾氣這麼壞，早晚會惹麻煩。

ex.zh: 我為他傲慢自大對他發火。

ex.zh: 一開頭她嚇壞了, 後來才定下神來。

ex.en: I was terrified.
ex.zh: 嚇死我了。

ex.zh: 別被嚇壞了。

ex.zh: 這些無限空間的永恆沉默使我恐懼。

ex.zh: 這種氣味真可怕。

ex.zh: 在公開場合說話讓我非常恐懼。

ex.zh: 這兩兄弟的性情很不一樣。

ex.zh: 沉穩的性格對護理師來說很重要。

ex.zh: 軍隊占領了整個領土。

ex.en: They increased the territory of the empire.
ex.zh: 他們擴張了帝國的領土。

ex.en: China's territory is vast, thus the types of tea vary.
ex.zh: 中國幅員遼闊，所以茶的種類很多。

ex.en: Hey, twirp! This here is our territory!
ex.zh: 喂，小鬼！這裡是我們的地盤！

ex.en: You're stepping into dangerous territory.
ex.zh: 你正踏進危險的領域。

ex.en: Our website features testimonials from happy customers.
ex.zh: 我們的網站刊登了滿意顧客的推薦。

ex.en: The ad includes a testimonial from a famous chef.
ex.zh: 這支廣告有一位知名主廚的推薦。

ex.en: When the landlord's away, the tenants will play.
ex.zh: 房東不在，房客就放肆起來了。

ex.en: The tenants complained about the noise.
ex.zh: 房客們抱怨噪音問題。

ex.en: That technician is highly skilled.
ex.zh: 那位技師技術很好。

ex.en: A technician will come to fix the printer this afternoon.
ex.zh: 今天下午會有技術人員來修印表機。

ex.en: Our payment terms are 30 days from the invoice date.
ex.zh: 我們的付款條件是開立請款單後 30 天內。

ex.en: They offered us better terms than other suppliers.
ex.zh: 他們給的條件比其他供應商好。

ex.en: This hotel is conveniently located in terms of public transportation.
ex.zh: 就大眾運輸來說，這家飯店的位置很方便。

ex.en: She thinks of everything in terms of money.
ex.zh: 她凡事都從錢的角度來想。

terms.zh: come to terms with：接受（事實）；達成協議

ex.en: After all they came to terms with each other.
ex.zh: 最後他們終於達成了協議。

ex.en: It took him years to come to terms with his father's death.
ex.zh: 他花了好幾年才接受父親過世的事實。

ex.en: A teleconference let the Singapore and Taipei offices compare their quarterly results.
ex.zh: 透過電話會議，新加坡與台北辦公室得以比較季度成果。

ex.en: The supplier joined the teleconference from its factory floor.
ex.zh: 供應商在工廠現場加入了電話會議。

ex.en: The company uses telemarketing to reach new clients.
ex.zh: 公司透過電話行銷接觸新客戶。

ex.en: She manages a telemarketing team in Taipei.
ex.zh: 她在台北管理一支電話行銷團隊。

ex.en: The tenancy agreement expires at the end of September.
ex.zh: 租賃契約將於九月底到期。

ex.en: Both parties signed a tenancy contract for twelve months.
ex.zh: 雙方簽署了一年期租賃契約。

ex.en: International flights depart from Terminal 2.
ex.zh: 國際航班從第二航廈出發。

ex.en: There is a free shuttle between the two terminals.
ex.zh: 兩個航廈之間有免費接駁車。

ex.en: He was diagnosed with terminal cancer.
ex.zh: 他被診斷出癌症末期。

ex.en: The hospital provides special care for terminal patients.
ex.zh: 這家醫院為末期病人提供特別照護。

ex.en: This bus goes all the way to the terminus.
ex.zh: 這班公車一路開到終點站。

ex.en: Everyone has to get off at the terminus.
ex.zh: 所有人都要在終點站下車。

ex.en: Kyoto is famous for its old temples.
ex.zh: 京都以古寺聞名。

ex.en: There used to be an old temple here.
ex.zh: 這裡以前有一座老廟。

ex.en: Do you know which deity this temple is dedicated to?
ex.zh: 您知道這座廟宇供奉的是哪個神嗎？

ex.en: He rubbed his temples because of a headache.
ex.zh: 他因為頭痛而揉著太陽穴。

ex.en: There's a small scar on her left temple.
ex.zh: 她左邊太陽穴有一道小疤。

ex.en: He is used to teamwork.
ex.zh: 他習慣團隊合作。

ex.en: Good teamwork helped us finish the project early.
ex.zh: 良好的團隊合作讓我們提早完成專案。

ex.en: Five companies submitted tenders for the project.
ex.zh: 有五家公司投標這個工程。

ex.en: The government invited tenders for the new bridge.
ex.zh: 政府公開招標興建新橋。

ex.en: She gave him a tender kiss.
ex.zh: 她給了他一個溫柔的吻。

ex.en: She has a tender heart.
ex.zh: 她心地很溫柔。

tender.zh: （肉）嫩的；（身體部位）一碰就痛的

ex.en: The steak was very tender.
ex.zh: 牛排很嫩。

ex.en: My ankle is still tender.
ex.zh: 我的腳踝一碰還是會痛。

ex.en: Please read the terms and conditions carefully.
ex.zh: 請仔細閱讀條款與細則。

ex.en: We agreed on the terms of the deal.
ex.zh: 我們對交易條件達成了共識。

ex.en: The term "qipao" is widely used in Northern China.
ex.zh: 「旗袍」這個詞在中國北方很常用。

ex.en: "ROI" is a common business term.
ex.zh: ROI 是常見的商業術語。

ex.en: I should have studied harder before the term exams.
ex.zh: 期末考前我應該更用功一點的。

ex.en: I was busy studying for the term exam.
ex.zh: 我忙著準備期末考。

ex.en: How much do you want in terms of salary?
ex.zh: 薪水方面，您希望多少？

ex.en: In terms of price, this phone is the best choice.
ex.zh: 就價格而言，這支手機是最好的選擇。

ex.en: Jim is on bad terms with his classmates.
ex.zh: 吉姆和同學關係不太好。

ex.en: I'm still on good terms with my ex.
ex.zh: 我跟前任還保持不錯的關係。

ex.en: Either party may terminate the contract with 30 days' notice.
ex.zh: 任何一方都可以提前 30 天通知終止合約。

ex.en: The agreement was terminated last year.
ex.zh: 這項協議去年就終止了。

ex.en: We're not terminating you.
ex.zh: 我們不會解僱你。

ex.en: He was terminated for breaking company rules.
ex.zh: 他因為違反公司規定而被解僱。

ex.en: I telecommute two days a week.
ex.zh: 我每週有兩天在家上班。

ex.en: More companies now allow employees to telecommute.
ex.zh: 現在有更多公司允許員工遠距工作。
